verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that you describe what you want in plain language and Claude Code plans, writes code across multiple files, and verifies it. Feature implementation from issues and bug-report-to-PR flows are also documented, and community users report daily real-world use, including implementing an app with minimal guidance. Hands-on reports of erroneous edits and failures concern reliability rather than whether the capability exists, so they lower confidence instead of creating a dispute. Missing for 10: consistent independent corroboration of reliable multi-file fixes, and evidence that self-verification actually catches errors.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have the agent implement or fix it across multiple files

citations.quote: Describe what you want in plain language. Claude Code plans the approach, writes the code across multiple files, and verifies it works.
mention @Claude in Slack with a bug report and get a pull request back
It understands your entire codebase and can work across multiple files and tools to get things done.
the agents researched, designed, and implemented a compelling app idea with minimal guidance
